title: Awajima Hyakkei
synopsis:
Awajima Revue School is known for its extensive performing and art studies. Every year, many aspiring performers and artists enroll in the school from various backgrounds, with the determination to pursue their own careers. However, very few students ever reach the grand stage, which results in many abandoning their ambitions before ever unlocking their true potential. Throughout the years, the past and new students leave many tales, which hopefully motivate future generations to chase their dreams and leave their own mark.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
